name: Timely affordable evidence
principle: Every choice between alternatives is backed by a current result, and what it cost to get was proportionate to the choice and approved.
state_description: Before choosing, anyone can see when each alternative was measured, on which commit and cases, and whether what it measures has changed since; each metric was run when a decision needed it and its cost was worth what it taught.
hints_of_measurement: Every selection cites a current result, no paid run lacks an approval, and the number of stale results found late stays near zero.
